document.note: [Unclassified] CIA document released to the media in 1998. It covers the birth, education and professional career of the Taliban leader, including time as a subcommander of a faction of the Afghan resistance.

key_claims: Omar was a subcommander in Yunis Khalis' Hizb-i Islami-Khalis faction during the Soviet occupation.
Omar founded the Taliban in 1994 and became its leader.
In 1996 Omar was named Amir-ul-Momineen at a Taliban-convened gathering of scholars and clerics.
Omar's religious education is reported to be limited despite being a religious scholar in his youth.
Omar was born around 1950 in Nodeh Village, Qandahar province.
